0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 14th in the West, on a three-game losing streak), with the Magic 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road while the Kings are 0-5 at home. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, 24.5 points per game this season), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). There have been no meetings yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Magic won both games of the 2025-26 series, including a 121-117 victory in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
